description: Delete your resort profile, guest notes, bundles and snapshots and revoke all sessions. Requires agent_id and session. Payment reconciliation hashes remain for 30 days. Pass the exact session string returned by check_in as session (64 lowercase hex characters). Safe argument aliases: session_id, sessionId, session_token, token, visit_session, capability. For MCP, the same value may be sent as the Mcp-Session-Id header after check_in. Keep it private; never put it in a URL. Pass the exact agent_id returned by check_in (96 lowercase hex characters), together with the session for that same guest when required. agent_id is not a session. Keep it private; never put it in a URL.

Keep it private; never put it in a URL. Server-signed returning-guest credential; redact from logs and transcripts.
